//Email: 21.1 — outbound SMTP. Disabled by default; the app never sends email unless Enabled=true AND Host/FromAddress are set. Set the password from the environment (Email__Password), never here. Env form: Email__Enabled, Email__Host, Email__Port, Email__Username, Email__Password, Email__UseSsl, Email__FromAddress, Email__FromName, Email__AppBaseUrl.
//Digests: 22.1 — notification email digests. A background scheduler batches each opted-in user's in-app notifications into a periodic email (Off/Daily/Weekly per user). Enabled by default but no-ops unless the Email transport above is configured. Set Digests__Enabled=false to disable the scheduler entirely; Digests__IntervalSeconds tunes how often it wakes (min 60, default 900).
